_comment: The renderer's bundle budget (issue #101). No specification governs this:
our own design, adopted from the family recipe.
max_gzip_bytes is the ceiling. It was first set from arithmetic over the
screens still to land, and that arithmetic was wrong: the three features it
was guessing about (#101, #138, #137) came in at 441161 gzipped against a
420000 guess. It is now set from MEASUREMENT of what is built plus a named
allowance, and issue #154 is the work that brings it back down.
Two reductions have landed: external tagging saved 33269 (#171) and the
living style guide left the release bundle for the `design` cargo feature,
saving 51506 (#154). Reading the layout overlay cost 16747 (#201).
Headroom is 70679, and the last feature of comparable scale to #27 cost
173294, so #154 is not finished and #27 still waits.
max_growth_gzip_bytes is what ONE change may add. measured_gzip_bytes is
what CI last produced on main, and it is the baseline a pull request is
charged against; the baseline is read from the merge base rather than from
the branch, so a change cannot make itself green by editing a number here.
step_change names a growth in advance, with its reason and its issue. It is
honoured only when the build measures that figure within the same tolerance
a recorded figure gets, so a stanza left behind permits nothing further.
